    OUR PROJECTS

    About Us

    Blue Marble Ltd. specializes in the purchase of property of historical significance and the restoration and development of this unique property into luxury housing. These projects are located in highly desirable urban areas.


    Blue Marble Ltd. utilizes the finest available resources and always aspires to excellence,
    providing only the highest quality of service and satisfaction to its clients.

    Read More

    Urban Development at its Finest

    Blue Marble Ltd. is a privately-owned, boutique real estate developer.

    We present innovative luxury properties in highly desirable locations.

    Each project is designed and built to the highest standards, right 
    down to the finest details. 

    We locate exceptional opportunities in commercial, residential and hospitality niches, and bring in world-class talent to team with our
    in-house expertise. Blue Marble's aim is to apply our rare ability to identify and impact future trends, and lead vision through to fruition.
